The 2160-combo shotgun_scalper_grinder sweep aims to identify high-edge parameter combinations across multiple strategy dimensions (entry triggers, exit parameters, filters) that pass keeper gates (OP-22) and validate via OOS/real-fills per OP-20. ## Mechanism

The sweep would iterate over 2160 predefined parameter combinations (e.g., entry signal thresholds, stop/target multipliers, filter conditions) using historical SPY 5m bars and cached OPRA data. Keeper gates (OP-22: 104 automated tests including gym validators, walk-forward, and real-fills checks) would filter combos. Keepers would then undergo OOS validation (walk-forward held-out window) and real-fills validation (simulated OPRA slippage/fill rates on top 3 J days).

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: all 104 OP-22 tests must pass
- Walk-forward OOS: ratio >= 0.70 (per L05 time-normalized Sharpe)
- Real-fills validation: <20% divergence from BS-sim on top 3 J days (per L12)
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture on J winners must not decrease
- Concentration check: top-5 days <= 50% of P&L (per L04)
